video_title: Perk Says Luka Has Kobe’s MENTALITY + Draymond Is a LIABILITY for the Warriors

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins compares Luka Doncic's mentality to Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: Luka is the closest thing to Kobe Bryant that we've seen out of all the young guys
quotes.quote: Luka is the closest thing to Kobe Bryant that we've seen out of all the young guys that are coming up. You have to have the kahunas, the onions, to be able to perform and not give a damn on a stage like LA.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye discusses the Philadelphia 76ers' confidence
quotes.excerpt: The fact that they're doing that in a regular season shows such a level of confidence
quotes.quote: The fact that they're doing that in a regular season shows such a level of confidence that we can turn this on. I respect you, but I'm going to clown you in the middle of a game.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on Luka Doncic's need to improve his jump shot
quotes.excerpt: He's a great player, he got to figure out his jump shot or else Orlando's going to be
quotes.quote: He's a great player, he got to figure out his jump shot or else Orlando's going to be in the drums, the dull drums.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins ranks Luka Doncic as a top 10 offensive player
quotes.excerpt: Luka Doncic is already a top 10 offensive player in the history of the game
quotes.quote: Luka Doncic is already a top 10 offensive player in the history of the game. You can't name me 10 players that you would take over him offensively as far as getting a bucket or orchestrating or being the system offensively.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the Dallas Mavericks' reliance on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: The only person that could take away what Luka is doing is SGA
quotes.quote: The only person that could take away what Luka is doing is SGA. If SGA continues to go on this and he keeps his team top two in the West with no Chet and no JDub, he would be the only one because of this one fact.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins praises the depth and physicality of the Houston Rockets
quotes.excerpt: the depth of the Houston Rockets, the physicality, the length, they are lacking nothing
quotes.quote: the depth of the Houston Rockets, the physicality, the length, they are lacking nothing. I mean, they're coming in, they sub off their starting lineup, they're coming in with Marcus Smart off the bench. I believe even in that game he had 20 plus. And then they're coming with Tari Eason and then, you know, you got Clint Capela or Steven Adams. You got so many. And I'm sitting up here saying, damn. And that damn Amen Thompson, watching him up and close, he looks like a damn action figure. But what he's able to do on the floor, how versatile he is, shout out to Ime Udoka because what I've witnessed is, I watched him push the ball at times, I watched him run screen and roll at times, and majority of the times I'm watching him actually be the screener.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on Nick Nurse's defensive versatility
quotes.excerpt: One thing that Nick Nurse is great at is stacking his defensive versatility
quotes.quote: One thing that Nick Nurse is great at is stacking his defensive versatility. So right now, you know what they're doing? You want to know why they're kind of losing some of these games? He's putting them in situations where they're going to have to adjust.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins criticizes Draymond Green's recent performance
quotes.excerpt: Draymond has been more of a liability than an asset
quotes.quote: Draymond has been more of a liability than an asset. And look, we know that he's known for as one of the best defensive players that we've ever seen. I get that. But I'm talking about this season. This season, he's got to give more, dog. Three points, 38% from the field, 26% from the three. Like, we haven't, unless it comes to fighting, this is our first time even having a discussion about Draymond and his impact on the game. And that's not okay.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the Golden State Warriors' core and Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.excerpt: The only person that they traded was Michael Porter Jr. out their core
quotes.quote: The only person that they traded was Michael Porter Jr. out their core. Like, the fans, they need some new life, bro. They want new energy. Not trading Jokic, they just want other, like they need it. And I wouldn't be surprised if Jokic wants it.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Russell Westbrook's impact as a teammate
quotes.excerpt: Russ is the godfather of my middle son Kingston
quotes.quote: Russ is the godfather of my middle son Kingston. The Perkins household, no matter, I know we have our back and forth on television, but we fuck with Russell West, we fuck with Russell Westbrook. That's how I got. Like, real talk.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Transfer portal has disrupted high school recruiting and scouting
quotes.excerpt: the transfer portal has completely disrupted the way that recruit recruiting is happening
quotes.quote: Some of these unsigned seniors, because the transfer portal has completely disrupted the way that recruit recruiting is happening, right? So, if you are not top 75 or top 100, you are not even catching the first wave of being able to commit to the Division 1 college. You have to wait till March if you are coming out of high school. So you always want to search to find those sleepers that are going to be in your budget so you could get them on the scholarship and now you got some walking on campus.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: The reality of getting a college scholarship as a young player
quotes.excerpt: If you are that dude, they will find you.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: Can Perk sign a high school senior to a college scholarship in two years?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: He knows it. He knows it.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Everything is, I am telling you, Perk made a great point about. There is you need one opportunity. That is all you need, right? And then I think if you can continue to show that you value that opportunity, ain't nobody care where you from, what you doing. If your goal is to support your family and then make it to the big leagues, you look at a lot of these guys and how they came. Maybe they go overseas, they come back. None of that matters anymore. Now, especially in today's game, there is three, maybe four guys that are 18 to 20 that are going to get a franchise. Other than that, you are a role player or you are a budding star. You are not a franchise guy because they will have already seen you for 10 years. I was with a GM six years ago and they were like, hey, at dinner, look at this guy from France. Victor was 14 years old and they already have film on him. So if you are that dude, they will find you. If not, take your time, become the best player ever, make $300 million, live wherever you want to live, and have a good life.
